title: Characteristic function of a correlated Gaussian pair
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $a,b\in\mathbb R^n$. For a pair $(X,Y)$ with the correlated Gaussian law obtained from independent standard Gaussian vectors by setting $Y_i=\rho X_i+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,Z_i$, the characteristic function of $\sum_i(a_iX_i+b_iY_i)$ is $\mathbb E[e^{i\sum_i(a_iX_i+b_iY_i)}]=\exp\!\left(-\frac12\sum_i(a_i^2+b_i^2+2\rho a_i b_i)\right)$.
